'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Serhiivka missile strike]]
****At least 21 civilians are killed and 38 others injured when two [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missiles strike a multi-story building and a recreation centre in [[Serhiivka]], [[Odesa Oblast]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/01/russian-missile-strikes-on-odesa-apartments-and-recreation-centre-kill-17-ukraine-says (''The Guardian'')]
*The [[Bulgarian Navy]] destroys a [[naval mine]] that had drifted close to the country's [[Black Sea]] coast in a [[controlled explosion]]. A team of divers stated that the mine was of [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] origin.  [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/bulgaria-destroys-naval-mine-off-its-black-sea-coast-2022-07-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Ukrainian cultural heritage during the 2022 Russian invasion]]
**[[UNESCO]] inscribes [[Ukraine]]'s [[borscht]] culture into its [[List of World Heritage in Danger|list of endangered]] [[intangible cultural heritage]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2338098/unesco-inscribes-ukrainian-borshch-soup-as-endangered-heritage (''Bangkok Post'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2019–present Sri Lankan economic crisis]]
**[[Sri Lanka]]'s [[inflation]] rate reaches a record 54.6% amid a steep [[economy of Sri Lanka|economic crisis]] and a default of the country's debt. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/sri-lanka-inflation-jumps-beyond-50-cent-2784806 (CNA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Hormozgan earthquakes]]
**Five people are killed and 49 are injured after a magnitude 6.1 [[earthquake]] hits [[Hormozgan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-iran-earthquake-least-three-27380182.amp (''Mirror'')]
*[[Argentina]] issues a notice of polar wave temperatures. The [[meteorological]] authorities also report that the country experienced one of the coldest autumns in more than 60 years. [https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2022/07/01/el-frio-intenso-regresa-el-fin-de-semana-en-ciudad-y-gran-buenos-aires/ (Infobae)]

*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Asia]]
***[[Turkey]] reports its first case of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkey-records-first-case-monkeypox-health-minister-2022-06-30/ (Reuters)] 
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Germany]]
***[[Germany]] surpasses 1,000 cases of monkeypox. [https://www.rki.de/DE/Content/InfAZ/A/Affenpocken/Ausbruch-2022-Situation-Deutschland.html (RKI Deutsche)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***[[Wisconsin]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.wisn.com/article/first-case-of-monkeypox-confirmed-in-wisconsin/40485712 (WISN-TV)]
**[[Puerto Rico]], [[Saint Lucia]] and the [[Bahamas]] report their first cases of monkeypox. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Ukraine]]
**Authorities in the [[Donetsk People's Republic]] announce that they will begin carrying out [[capital punishment]] in 2025, after three foreign fighters, two of them [[United Kingdom|British]] and the third [[Morocco|Moroccan]], who were arrested in the republic after joining the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian Army]] amidst the ongoing Russian invasion, are sentenced to death by the court. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-backed-separatists-start-using-death-penalty-2025-criminal-code-2022-07-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 shooting of Kentucky police officers]]
**A third police officer dies from injuries sustained in yesterday's shootout in [[Floyd County, Kentucky]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/kentucky-officers-killed-hurt-gunman-opened-fire-home/story?id=86076193 (ABC News)]
*The trial of American basketball player [[Brittney Griner]] begins in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]]. Griner was detained at a Moscow airport in February and could face up to ten years in prison if she is convicted on drug charges. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/detained-us-basketball-star-brittney-griner-arrives-russian-court-2022-07-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Philadelphia Flyers]] prospect and former [[HC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]] [[goaltender]] [[Ivan Fedotov]] is arrested in [[Saint Petersburg]] for allegedly [[Draft evasion|evading military service]]. [https://www.inquirer.com/flyers/flyers-goalie-ivan-fedotov-arrested-russia-20220701.html (''Philadelphia Inquirer'')]
